sentences.text: Laurence John Fishburne III -LRB- born July 30 , 1961 -RRB- is an American actor , playwright , director and producer , best known for playing Morpheus in The Matrix trilogy , Jason `` Furious '' Styles in the 1991 drama film Boyz n the Hood and Tyrone `` Mr. Clean '' Miller in the 1979 war film Apocalypse Now .	playwright	playwright	Morpheus	Morpheus (The Matrix)	The Matrix trilogy	The Matrix (franchise)	Boyz n the Hood	Boyz n the Hood	Apocalypse Now	Apocalypse Now

Fishburne became the first African American to portray Othello in a motion picture by a major studio when he appeared in Oliver Parker 's 1995 film adaptation of the Shakespeare play .
